name: DiffCompareCard
job: Compare two options side by side where only the rows that differ are highlighted and matching rows fade back
visitor_action: toggle "differences only" to fade matching rows away; hover or focus a row to read it
mobile: each row label sits above its two values; option names stay in two columns on top
motion: rows rise in with a light stagger; toggling differences-only fades and collapses the matching rows (reduced-motion: instant)
art_direction: Restrained editorial comparison: white sheet, one blue accent, IBM Plex Sans, hairline rules; differing rows get a faint accent tint and heavier values, matching rows recede to muted grey
